newsitem.title: CHINA: China calls for stable oil prices over festival.
newsitem.headline: China calls for stable oil prices over festival.

text.p: China has called on officials at all levels to create ample stocks of diesel and processed oil and to ensure steady prices over the Chinese New Year and spring planting seasons, the China Business Daily said on Monday.

A circular issued by the State Council, or cabinet, instructed officials to guarantee diesel supplies to industry during the festival season around Chinese Lunar New Year, which this year fell on February 7, the newspaper said.
Farmers carrying out spring planting should also be assured of access to oil supplies, it said.

The annual new year return of urban Chinese to their ancestral villages puts extra strain on public transport and diesel supplies, while increased agricultural mechinisation adds to the demand for oil products.

All departments should strictly adhere to the state plan for processed oil distribution and should create reserves of essential oil products, the China Business Daily said but gave no details of which kinds of processed oil would be targeted.
Officials should also strengthen monitoring of local oil companies and should strictly adhere to the state-set price policies, it said but did not elaborate.
